mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which lowers discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline in the prior 3 months fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for two months fails to generate negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) for two consecutive months signal a contracting housing sector that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST for two months fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing contraction (INDPRO decline), supply chain disruptions intensify, reducing corporate production capacity and profitability, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline fails to generate negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances during manufacturing contraction cycles, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates strong consumer confidence and housing market health, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS increase in the prior 3 months fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS above 4.5% for three months fails to generate negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten policy, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE below 4.5% for two months fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When manufacturing production (INDPRO) falls below 95% of its 12-month moving average for two consecutive months, it indicates a significant slowdown in industrial output, reducing corporate revenue and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 95% of 12-month moving average for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: INDPRO below 95% of 12-month moving average for two months fails to generate negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year window.
